newsitem.title: USA: Reeds Jewelers Sept same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Reeds Jewelers Sept same-store sales rise.

text.p: Reeds Jewelers Inc said Thursday that net sales for September increased 12 percent for the month ended September 30, 1996, to $5,837,000 from last year's record September sales of $5,192,000.
Comparable store sales for the month declined 10%.
Year-to-date sales rose 21 percent to $46,706,000 from $38,523,000 for the same period in fiscal 1996. For the seven months ended September 30, 1996, same store sales were flat.
